name: Missing Erase All
hint: If a sprite uses a [sbi]pen down[/sbi] block but never an [sbi]erase all[/sbi] block, then all drawings from a previous execution remain for the next run too.
instruction: If a sprite uses a [sbi]pen down[/sbi] block but never an [sbi]erase all[/sbi] block, then all drawings from a previous execution remain for the next run too.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
pen down
repeat (4)
move (10) steps
turn left (90) degrees
end
pen up

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
erase all //⇦  👍
pen down
repeat (4)
move (10) steps
turn left (90) degrees
end
pen up
